rows.text: calls `001B2410` on the result of the core runtime object fetch `001B1C00()`, as `001B2410(that, ecx, edx, r8, 0, r9d, 0, 1, 1, 0)` with the incoming `ecx`, `edx`, `r8` and `r9d`, the fifth to tenth as stack arguments

calls `00246480(rcx, &t)` and stores qword `t` at `[rdx]`; then, when `rcx` is non-null, for each node of the chain qword `+0x10` (from `rcx`'s) it calls `00246480(node, &t)` and adds words `t+0`/`t+2` to words `[rdx]`/`[rdx+2]`; the frame carries the stack cookie (`01F44830`, checked by `00808C40`)
